metadata.title: City of Elmina
metadata.extentDescription: A 1.5 km square OSM pilot window around a verified location anchor; not an official township boundary.
metadata.anchorDescription: Representative location returned by OSM Nominatim for the named Elmina residential way; verified 20 October 2026.
heightAssumptions: Missing OSM building height defaults to an illustrative 6 m.
Mapped building levels use an assumed 3 m per level.
Heights are visual only and do not establish surveyed elevations or flood exposure.
metadata.geometryNotes: Original complete OSM geometry is retained; intersecting features may extend beyond the query window. Closed rings and relation holes are preserved. Incomplete geometry is omitted, never invented.

identityChecks.name: Elmina Pavilion
identityChecks.description: Developer brochure GPS inside the pilot’s northeast corner. This window covers the Elmina Pavilion / Ilham vicinity and adjacent mapped neighbourhoods, not the entire City of Elmina.

identityChecks.name: Elmina Sales Gallery, Elmina West
identityChecks.description: Current developer page GPS about 1.02 km west of the OSM representative anchor, outside the pilot window. The pilot is not centred on this gallery or an official city centre.

namedBuildings.name: Harmoni 1 @ City of Elmina Show Units

coverageNotes: Mapped OSM footprints and roads are real source geometry, not a complete asset inventory or an official township boundary.
Building heights lack survey evidence. An OSM level count still requires an assumed 3 m per level; all other untagged heights use an illustrative 6 m.
Whole OSM ways are retained and may extend outside the query window; clip rendering to the stated window without changing source geometry.
Named-feature coordinates below are geometry-bounds centres for map inspection, not surveyed entrances or precise centroids.
The OSM representative point is in the Elmina Pavilion / Ilham vicinity; it is not the current Elmina West sales-gallery location or a verified City of Elmina centre.
